reviewNote: 核查 Steam 英文商店页完整 AI 披露、身份（开发商 Neurona Games）与英文讨论区首页（可见 15 个主题，总数 278），首页没有与 AI 使用直接相关的主题，未逐帖展开。本款单独检索公开报道 1 次、登记 6 条结果，读取 1 篇原始来源（AI Transparency Index 条目，只是对商店披露的转录）；一篇关于 Steam AI 游戏节的报道抓取返回 HTTP 454，未能读取。领域判定来自商店披露原文，结论基于开发者自述，未经独立审计。
disclosureQuote: AI was used for generation of players' faces and in-game logos.
disclosureQuoteNote: Steam 商店 AI 生成内容披露栏完整原文，2026-10-30 核查；可能随商店页更新。

english.summary: An esports organisation management sim. The developer states AI was used to generate players’ faces and in-game logos, and says nothing about the remaining areas.
english.reviewNote: Reviewed the full English Steam AI disclosure, the identity (developer Neurona Games) and the English discussion homepage (15 visible topics of 278); no homepage topic directly concerns AI use and individual threads were not opened. This title was searched once with 6 results logged and one raw source read (AI Transparency Index, a transcription of the store disclosure); an article about a Steam AI game festival returned HTTP 454 and could not be read. Area findings come from the store disclosure text and rest on developer statements, not an independent audit.
